referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The process includes the production, transport and disposal of the main materials for an agricultural biogas plant.
referenceFunction.name: Anaerobic digestion plant covered, agriculture

geography.text: This process refers to an agricultural biogas plant with a capacity of about 500m3. The data were sampled from 20 different plants in Switzerland.

technology.text: To avoid Methane emissions the new plants in Switzerland are covered.

representativeness.extrapolations: no extrapolation was necessary because the typical plants for the region and time period were evaluated
representativeness.samplingProcedure: The data are the average of 20 from 70 plants in Switzerland
